field_evidence.service_scope: The official GOV.UK/Valuation Office Agency service states that users can search the Council Tax valuation list for a home in England or Wales by address or postcode.
field_evidence.public_access: The search page is publicly reachable without login and presents a postcode input plus other search options.
field_evidence.target_window: Unused target workflow for Forge Cottage, Ruckinge Road, TN25 7JX; one source record was assessed and no result set was emitted by this transport.
field_evidence.transport_result: The available transport can read the search form but cannot submit the interactive postcode/address search, so no Forge Cottage valuation-list result is asserted in this batch.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: Council Tax valuation-list entries are dwelling/address and valuation-band records; this service does not provide an authoritative registered-title/index-polygon geometry, title number or canonical parcel bbox.
field_evidence.licensing_limit: The service page states Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated and separately notes Ordnance Survey terms for address and mapping data.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted. Any target title/parcel binding and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. The unused official Valuation Office Agency/GOV.UK Council Tax valuation-list service is public/no-login and supports home lookup by address or postcode, but the available transport can read the search form only and cannot submit the target Forge Cottage / TN25 7JX search. Even a returned valuation-list record would be dwelling/address and Council Tax band evidence, not an authoritative registered-title/index-polygon geometry, title number or canonical parcel bbox. Local OpenCode or another authoritative target-specific workflow must bind the exact registered-title/title-boundary polygon; after canonical bbox is bound, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from HM Land Registry Price Paid linked-data REST/JSON target-postcode retrieval to the Valuation Office Agency Council Tax valuation-list public property-search service. The search page is public/no-login and accepts a postcode, but this transport cannot submit the interactive target form, so no Forge Cottage valuation-list result is asserted. More importantly, Council Tax valuation data does not supply cadastral/title-boundary geometry. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
